stages.label: Build
stages.promise: Build agents from typed objects—and explicit authority.

stages.label: Trace
stages.promise: See every event, token, and tool call in the hierarchy.

stages.label: Attack
stages.promise: Break trust boundaries before users do.

stages.label: Guard
stages.promise: Put NeMo Guardrails at the right enforcement layer.

stages.label: Evaluate
stages.promise: Measure quality, safety, cost, and latency.

stages.label: Improve
stages.promise: Turn evidence into the next safer version.

repositories.name: NVIDIA-labs Object Oriented Agents
repositories.description: Research agents built from typed Python objects.
repositories.safetyNote: Code execution requires an OS-level sandbox; do not run untrusted agent code on the host.

repositories.name: NeMo Guardrails
repositories.description: Programmable rails for controlling LLM application behavior.
repositories.safetyNote: Guardrails are an enforcement layer, not a replacement for permissions, isolation, or secret management.

repositories.name: NeMo Evaluator
repositories.description: Benchmarks, solvers, and reports for repeatable AI evaluation.
repositories.safetyNote: Evaluation results are evidence for a decision, not proof of production safety.

repositories.name: NeMo Anonymizer
repositories.description: Detect and transform sensitive data before it reaches downstream systems.
repositories.safetyNote: Anonymizer does not replace document permissions, secret management, encryption, retention rules, or sandboxing.

lessons.title: Build Your First Python-Object Agent
lessons.summary: Create a narrow support agent from explicit Python objects and inspect its authority before it runs.

lessons.title: Define Typed Generation Methods and Contracts
lessons.summary: Turn a support outcome into typed generation methods with explicit inputs, outputs, and failure states.

lessons.title: Keep Authorization and Verification in Deterministic Python
lessons.summary: Keep permissions and verification in code instead of delegating trust decisions to the model.

lessons.title: Add a Scoped MCP Capability
lessons.summary: Add one authenticated MCP capability with narrow scope, validated arguments, and caller identity.

lessons.title: Understand NOOA Events and Trace Hierarchy
lessons.summary: Read object, agent, model, retrieval, and tool events as one correlated hierarchy.

lessons.title: Inspect a Nested Agent Trajectory
lessons.summary: Follow a nested support-agent trajectory and locate its first consequential decision.

lessons.title: Export an ATIF Trajectory
lessons.summary: Export a trace as ATIF while preserving event order, provenance, and failure context.

lessons.title: Observe Runs Without Leaking Sensitive Content
lessons.summary: Design telemetry and content-capture policies that keep sensitive prompts and results out of exported runs.

lessons.title: Threat-Model the Code-Executing Support Agent
lessons.summary: Map assets, actors, trust boundaries, abuse paths, and OS-level execution consequences.

lessons.title: Replay Jailbreak and Indirect Prompt-Injection Attacks
lessons.summary: Replay direct jailbreaks and retrieval-borne instructions across the agent boundary.

lessons.title: Attack Retrieval, Tools, MCP, and Agent Handoffs
lessons.summary: Test poisoning, overbroad retrieval, unsafe tool results, and authority expansion across handoffs.

lessons.title: Find PII Leakage Across Prompts, Traces, and Providers
lessons.summary: Find sensitive data crossing prompts, traces, provider boundaries, and retained artifacts.

lessons.title: Configure NeMo Guardrails’ Five Rail Types
lessons.summary: Apply input, dialog, retrieval, execution/tool, and output rails using version-declared Colang.

lessons.title: Enforce Tool Inputs, Outputs, and Side Effects
lessons.summary: Validate tool names, arguments, results, execution context, permissions, and side effects.

lessons.title: Detect and Transform Sensitive Data with NeMo Anonymizer
lessons.summary: Compare redact, annotate, deterministic hash, and contextual substitute strategies.

lessons.title: Compare Jailbreak Controls and Runtime Boundaries
lessons.summary: Compare heuristic and model-based controls with runtime isolation and their residual bypass risk.

lessons.title: Build a NeMo Evaluator BYOB Safety Benchmark
lessons.summary: Build a bring-your-own-benchmark safety dataset with defensible cases and expected behavior.

lessons.title: Execute and Report a `nel eval run`
lessons.summary: Run the NeMo Evaluator CLI and report benchmark results with provenance and limitations.

lessons.title: Compare Baseline and Guarded Versions with `nel compare`
lessons.summary: Compare identical cases across baseline and guarded versions without inventing unsupported metrics.

lessons.title: Convert Every Attack into a Regression Case
lessons.summary: Turn each discovered failure into a repeatable evaluation case and release gate input.

lessons.title: Choose the Simplest Safe Agent Architecture
lessons.summary: Decide when deterministic code, an object agent, retrieval, or guardrails is justified.

lessons.title: Define a Decision-Grade `nel gate`
lessons.summary: Define explicit quality, safety, cost, latency, and evidence thresholds for a release decision.

lessons.title: Pass the Production Release Gate
lessons.summary: Release, revise, or reject using ownership, evaluation, rollback, and isolation evidence.

lessons.title: Operate, Observe, Learn, and Repeat
lessons.summary: Convert production observations and residual risk into the next measurable improvement loop.
